EFS/S18.title: Android: camera / mic permissions, offline, failure states (device)
EFS/S18.stated: TFA-92570 AC 3 / TFA-92587 AC 3 ('Take Photo' opens the camera)
EFS/S18.detail: Manual: the Android rig (debug build for the local stack) was built from e02167f and is not rebuilt for 8b4be94a; device-only. Code re-check: AndroidManifest.xml <queries> still lists only the speech RecognitionService (no android.media.action.IMAGE_CAPTURE), targetSdk 36, camera only through <input capture=environment>; nothing under apps/web/android changed since e02167f, so N9 is still there by code.
